# Maharashtra Times Swasthya Sangam 2026

> Health, Wellness & Healthcare Summit & Awards. A Healthier Maharashtra for a Brighter Tomorrow. Presented by Maharashtra Times and Times Internet Languages Live. Mumbai, November 2026. Hashtag: #SwasthyaSangam2026.

Swasthya Sangam is a one-day meeting point for hospitals, doctors, pharma companies, diagnostics labs, MedTech innovators, wellness brands, insurers and AYUSH practitioners in Maharashtra. It combines a Summit, an Expo, Masterclasses and Awards. Audience: Mumbai, Pune, Thane, Navi Mumbai and the rest of Maharashtra.

Facts: City Mumbai; Month November 2026; exact date and venue are yet to be announced; languages English, Marathi and Hindi (to be confirmed).

## FAQ
Q: What is Swasthya Sangam?
A: A health summit, expo, masterclass and awards event by Maharashtra Times in Mumbai.

Q: Who can nominate?
A: Any hospital, doctor, brand or organisation that meets the eligibility rules.

Q: Is there a fee to nominate?
A: Nomination fee details will be announced shortly.

Q: Can I attend without a nomination?
A: Yes. Anyone can register to attend.

Q: How are winners picked?
A: An independent jury scores each nomination.

Q: How do I book an Expo stall?
A: Use the Talk to Our Team button in the Partner With Us section, or write to the sponsorship team listed under Contact.
